column1: # DAQ capability test matrix. Tab-separated only; preserve empty fields.
# Lines whose first non-space character is # and empty lines are ignored.
# REQUIRED marks a safety or business threshold that must be reviewed before an enabled case can run.
# case_name: unique stable identifier; selects case-specific required fields. enabled: exactly true or false; false skips preflight semantics.
# device: DAQNavi description; PCI-1714,BID#0 is the lab board/default board index and must match installed hardware.
# mode: allowed preflight, capability, acquire, segment_phase, phase_stitch, trigger, delay_trigger.
# sample_channel/reference_channel: zero-based AI channel numbers; defaults AI0/AI1 exercise primary/reference inputs.
# value_range: signed voltage endpoints in <number>V~<number>V format.
# sample_rate_hz: positive samples/second/channel; 1 MHz is the nominal boundary rate, while 500/200/100 kHz probe low-rate behavior.
# points_per_channel: positive samples/channel; 16 million stresses long acquisition and requires sufficient RAM.
# repeat_count: positive repetitions; default 3 detects run-to-run drift. timeout_seconds: positive command timeout in seconds.
# signal_frequency_hz: positive applied input frequency in Hz for low-rate/phase cases. min_complete_cycles: positive count for low-rate cases.
# min_signal_span_v: required >0 peak-to-peak volts for low-rate/dual/phase cases.
# max_edge_jitter_us: required >0 microseconds for phase and trigger cases.
# reference_duty_cycle_percent: reference high-time duty in percent, strictly (0,100); phase rows default to 50.
# max_duty_cycle_error_percent: non-negative absolute duty error tolerance in percentage points.
# target_waveforms: comma-separated positive integer waveform counts for phase_stitch. phase_bin_count: positive phase_stitch histogram bin count.
# min_samples_per_bin: positive minimum samples in each phase bin.
# min_overlap_percent: phase_stitch threshold in percent, strictly >0 and <=100.
# max_overlap_error_v/max_response_drift_v/max_boundary_jump_v: phase_stitch voltage limits, each >=0 volts.
# max_attempts: positive phase_stitch acquisition attempt limit.
# trigger_source: non-empty trigger input for trigger modes. trigger_edge: allowed rising or falling.
# trigger_action: allowed none or delay_to_start for trigger modes.
# trigger_delay_counts: comma-separated non-negative hardware counts (at least two); count units are never inferred from sample rate.
# trigger_delay_target_phase_percent: expected start phase for each count, same length as trigger_delay_counts, each in [0,100).
# delay_trigger first measures a reference calibration, probes each count with a long window, then validates short windows; max_delay_position_error_us is the independent phase tolerance.
# Safety: disconnect uncontrolled sources and confirm input range, grounding, memory, and trigger wiring before enabling.
